brief:
The Palestinian Authority called Saturday for international pressure on Israel following an operation that forced more than 1,500 people from their homes in Hebron, Middle East Eye reported. The authority did not specify details of the Israeli action or provide a timeline for the displacement.

The call represents a diplomatic response to what Palestinian officials characterized as a threat to civilians in the occupied city. The displacement occurred in Hebron, where Israeli and Palestinian populations coexist amid heavy Israeli military presence.

title: Palestinian Authority demands international action over Israeli Hebron expulsion
